atAGlance: Nước ép cần tây is celery juice from Vietnam’s health-drink café lane, green, herbal, lightly bitter, and best ordered with sugar in mind.
whatItIs: Nước ép cần tây is celery pressed into a cold juice, sometimes mixed with apple or pineapple. Expect celery juice that is green, herbal, lightly bitter, and very fresh.
howToEnjoy: Ask what it is mixed with if you want to avoid extra sweetness.
howLocalsOrder: Nước ép cần tây is usually made or poured cold, so ask no sugar, less sugar, or no ice before the glass is finished. Fresh fruit versions taste best when the flavor stays tart, pulpy, or fragrant.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước ép cần tây fits the health-drink side of Vietnamese juice stalls and modern cafés.
